blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ATMP 物料合格審定 (Material Qualification) 的風險導向框架，並能區分臨床早期與商業化階段的不同要求。
blocks.en: Understand the risk-based framework for ATMP material qualification and distinguish the different expectations for early clinical and commercial stages.

blocks.zh: 掌握生物安全關鍵物料屬性 (Critical Material Attribute: Biological Safety) 的核心管控要求，包含 TSE/BSE、病毒安全性及無菌保證的限制。
blocks.en: Master the core control requirements for the critical material attribute of biological safety, including TSE/BSE, viral safety and the limits of sterility assurance.

blocks.zh: 能夠解讀 Table 3.2-1🔍（微生物/病毒安全性法規概覽）及 Table 3.2-2🔍（美國 vs 歐盟 ID 測試法規比較），並應用於 CDMO 實際工作。
blocks.en: Be able to interpret Table 3.2-1🔍 (overview of microbial/viral safety regulations) and Table 3.2-2🔍 (comparison of US and EU ID testing regulations), and apply them in day-to-day CDMO work.

blocks.zh: 理解美國 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2) 與歐盟 EudraLex Vol. 4 在身份鑑別測試 (ID Testing) 上的關鍵差異，並能為 ATMP 製造設計合規策略。
blocks.en: Understand the key differences between US 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2) and EU EudraLex Vol. 4 on identity (ID) testing, and be able to design a compliance strategy for ATMP manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 區分自體 (Autologous) 與異體 (Allogeneic) 細胞治療在物料測試上的差異要求，包含供體同意書的商業化注意事項。
blocks.en: Distinguish the different material testing expectations for autologous and allogeneic cell therapies, including commercialization considerations for donor consent.

blocks.zh: 了解取樣及留樣策略 (Material Sampling and Retain Requirements) 對 ATMP 的特殊挑戰，並能說明合理的豁免依據。
blocks.en: Understand the particular challenges that material sampling and retain requirements pose for ATMPs, and be able to explain a reasonable basis for exemption.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 風險導向合格審定框架
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Risk-Based Qualification Framework

blocks.zh: Risk-Based Material Qualification (風險導向物料合格審定): 意即不對每種物料採用相同的嚴格度，而是依據物料對病患安全與產品品質的影響程度，分層級分配測試資源。
blocks.en: Risk-Based Material Qualification: Instead of applying the same level of rigor to every material, testing resources are allocated in tiers according to the impact of the material on patient safety and product quality.

blocks.zh: Phase-Appropriate (階段適切性): 臨床 Phase I 的物料合規要求，可比商業化生產寬鬆許多。隨著臨床進展，要求逐步升級。這是 ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 生命週期管理概念在物料層面的落地。
blocks.en: Phase-Appropriate: Material compliance expectations for a Phase I clinical study can be considerably more relaxed than for commercial manufacturing, and they step up as the program advances. This is how the lifecycle management concept of ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 is put into practice at the material level.

blocks.zh: Critical Material Attributes (CMA，關鍵物料屬性): 對應產品的 CQA（關鍵品質屬性），CMA 是物料本身必須符合的特性，例如：特定細胞激素的生物活性、質體的純度和序列完整性。
blocks.en: Critical Material Attributes (CMA): The counterpart of the product CQA (critical quality attribute). A CMA is a characteristic the material itself must meet, for example the biological activity of a specific cytokine or the purity and sequence integrity of a plasmid.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 餐廳食材採購的分級管理
blocks.en: Analogy — Tiered Ingredient Purchasing in a Restaurant

blocks.zh: 想像一家高檔餐廳的食材採購策略：食鹽（非人/動物來源、低風險）只需看供應商 CoA；牛排（動物來源、中風險）要求產地證明和動物健康檢查；主廚特選生魚（高風險、直接入口）則每批到貨都要自己驗微生物。
blocks.en: Picture the ingredient purchasing strategy of a high-end restaurant. Table salt (not of human/animal origin, low risk) only needs the supplier CoA. Beef steak (animal origin, medium risk) calls for a certificate of origin and animal health inspection. The chef's special raw fish (high risk, eaten as is) is tested for microbes by the restaurant itself on every delivery.

blocks.zh: ATMP 物料合格審定的邏輯完全相同——風險越高（越接近病患、越難後處理），合格審定就越嚴格、測試就越多。這就是「風險導向」的本質：把有限的測試資源花在刀刃上。
blocks.en: The logic of ATMP material qualification is exactly the same: the higher the risk (the closer to the patient and the harder to process afterwards), the stricter the qualification and the more testing is done. That is the essence of "risk-based": spend limited testing resources where they matter most.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — CDMO 的 Supplier Management 義務
blocks.en: Key Point — The CDMO's Supplier Management Obligations

blocks.zh: PtC-13 明確指出：臨床試驗申辦者（即製造商）有責任向供應商索取並管理 CoA、Certificate of Origin（產地/來源證明）及物料編號，因為健康主管機關在 IND/IMPD 及 BLA/MAA 審核時，必定要求可追溯性文件。
blocks.en: PtC-13 states clearly that the clinical trial sponsor (that is, the manufacturer) is responsible for obtaining and managing the CoA, Certificate of Origin and material lot numbers from suppliers, because health authorities will always require traceability documentation when reviewing an IND/IMPD or BLA/MAA.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務建議：在接受新客戶 ATMP 委託時，應在 Quality Agreement 中明確規定客戶提供這些文件的時間節點，避免因文件缺失延誤批次放行或法規申請。
blocks.en: CDMO practice recommendation: when accepting a new ATMP client, specify in the Quality Agreement when the client must provide these documents, so that missing documentation does not delay batch release or regulatory submissions.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 的物料合格審定分層策略
blocks.en: Practical Application — A Tiered Material Qualification Strategy for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 同時承接多個 ATMP 計畫，物料合格審定如何規劃？建議依以下三層分類：
blocks.en: A CDMO handles several ATMP programs at the same time. How should material qualification be planned? We suggest the following three tiers:

blocks.zh: Tier 1（最高風險）: 人/動物來源物料（FBS、人血清）→ 每批次完整測試，供應商需提供 TSE/BSE 憑證。
blocks.en: Tier 1 (highest risk): Materials of human/animal origin (FBS, human serum) → full testing of every lot; the supplier must provide a TSE/BSE certificate.

blocks.zh: Tier 2（中等風險）: 直接接觸製程的試劑（細胞激素、質體）→ 收貨 ID 測試 + 依 CoA 驗收其他參數。
blocks.en: Tier 2 (medium risk): Reagents in direct contact with the process (cytokines, plasmids) → ID testing on receipt, with other parameters accepted on the basis of the CoA.

blocks.zh: Tier 3（低風險）: 化學定義培養基成分（無動物來源）→ 依供應商 CoA 驗收，定期稽核供應商。
blocks.en: Tier 3 (low risk): Chemically defined medium components (no animal origin) → accept on the basis of the supplier CoA and audit the supplier periodically.

blocks.zh: 此策略對應 USP <1043> Ancillary Materials 的分層概念（Tier 1–3）。
blocks.en: This strategy mirrors the tiering concept (Tiers 1-3) of USP <1043> Ancillary Materials.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一個 Phase I 的 CAR-T 製造計畫，使用了含有 FBS 的培養基，從風險導向角度，您會建議哪些最低限度的合格審定措施？
blocks.en: A Phase I CAR-T manufacturing program uses a medium containing FBS. From a risk-based perspective, what minimum qualification measures would you recommend?

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 2A Section 5.23 與 ICH Q9 在物料合格審定的風險評估方法上有何互補關係？
blocks.en: How do PIC/S Annex 2A Section 5.23 and ICH Q9 complement each other in the risk assessment approach to material qualification?

blocks.zh: 為何「phase-appropriate」的概念在 ATMP 領域特別重要？與傳統小分子藥物相比有何差異？
blocks.en: Why is the concept of "phase-appropriate" especially important in the ATMP field, and how does it differ from traditional small-molecule drugs?

blocks.zh: Q3.2 General Requirements — Critical Material Attribute: Biological Safety Q3.2 一般要求 — 關鍵物料屬性：生物安全性
blocks.en: Q3.2 General Requirements — Critical Material Attribute: Biological Safety

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — Q3.2 的雙重安全要求
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Dual Safety Requirement in Q3.2

blocks.zh: Q3.2 的「一般要求」實際上涵蓋兩個截然不同的安全面向：
blocks.en: The "general requirements" of Q3.2 actually cover two quite different aspects of safety:

blocks.zh: 生物安全 (Biological Safety): 防止人/動物病原體（病毒、TSE/BSE、支原體）傳播給病患——這是生物學層面的風險。
blocks.en: Biological Safety: Preventing the transmission of human/animal pathogens (viruses, TSE/BSE, mycoplasma) to the patient. This is a biological risk.

blocks.zh: 無菌保證 (Sterility Assurance): 防止微生物（細菌、真菌）在製造過程中汙染產品——這是製程層面的風險。
blocks.en: Sterility Assurance: Preventing microorganisms (bacteria, fungi) from contaminating the product during manufacture. This is a process risk.

blocks.zh: 兩者不能混淆：一個「無菌」的物料，仍然可能帶有 TSE 病原體（Prion）；而一個有 TSE 憑證的物料，未必符合 Eur. Ph. 5.1.1 的無菌保證。
blocks.en: The two must not be confused: a "sterile" material can still carry a TSE agent (prion), and a material with a TSE certificate does not necessarily meet the sterility assurance expectations of Eur. Ph. 5.1.1.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — TSE/BSE 就像食安界的「狂牛症問題」
blocks.en: Analogy — TSE/BSE Is Like the "Mad Cow Problem" in Food Safety

blocks.zh: TSE（Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies，傳播性海綿狀腦病）和 BSE（Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy，牛海綿狀腦病，俗稱「狂牛症」）是由Prion（普利昂蛋白）引起的，這種蛋白異常折疊後無法被一般的滅菌方法（高壓滅菌、伽馬射線）消滅。
blocks.en: TSE (Transmissible Spongiform Encephalopathies) and BSE (Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy, commonly known as "mad cow disease") are caused by prions, misfolded proteins that cannot be eliminated by ordinary sterilization methods (autoclaving, gamma irradiation).

blocks.zh: 類比：就像一塊牛肉，即使高溫烹調後可殺死所有細菌，但若牛隻本身帶有 Prion，吃進去後仍可能致病。這就是為何動物來源物料需要「受控來源 (controlled sourcing)」——從頭就要確保原料來自無 BSE 風險的牛群。對 ATMP 而言，FBS（胎牛血清）是最常見的 TSE/BSE 風險來源，供應商必須提供TSE/BSE 憑證，說明原料來源地（例如：紐西蘭或澳洲是公認的低風險地區）。
blocks.en: By analogy: even if cooking a piece of beef at high temperature kills all the bacteria, eating it can still cause disease if the animal carried prions. That is why animal-derived materials require "controlled sourcing", ensuring from the start that the raw material comes from herds free of BSE risk. For ATMPs, FBS (fetal bovine serum) is the most common source of TSE/BSE risk, and the supplier must provide a TSE/BSE certificate stating the country of origin (for example, New Zealand and Australia are recognized as low-risk regions).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Eur. Ph. 5.1.1 的無菌保證限制
blocks.en: Key Point — The Limits of Sterility Assurance under Eur. Ph. 5.1.1

blocks.zh: 這是 PtC-13 非常重要的實務提醒：大多數 ATMP 物料供應商，即使提供了 0.2 µm 過濾憑證，也無法保證符合 Eur. Ph. 5.1.1 的無菌保證標準（該標準要求特定的生物指示劑 (BI) 驗證，並非僅靠過濾）。
blocks.en: This is a very important practical reminder from PtC-13: most ATMP material suppliers cannot guarantee compliance with the sterility assurance standard of Eur. Ph. 5.1.1, even when they provide a 0.2 µm filtration certificate (the standard requires validation with a specific biological indicator (BI), not filtration alone).

blocks.zh: 因此，這些物料應被視為「非無菌原料 (nonsterile raw materials)」。這對 CDMO 的 GMP 操作影響重大：
blocks.en: These materials should therefore be treated as "nonsterile raw materials". This has a major impact on GMP operations at a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 這些物料進入無菌製程前，必須經過已驗證的 0.2 µm 過濾步驟 + 過濾器完整性測試 (filter integrity test)。
blocks.en: Before these materials enter the sterile process, they must pass through a validated 0.2 µm filtration step plus a filter integrity test.

blocks.zh: 或者對這些物料執行 USP <71> 無菌測試或 USP <61> 微生物計數測試（TAMC/TYMC），並設定嚴格的限度標準。
blocks.en: Alternatively, perform USP <71> sterility testing or USP <61> microbial enumeration testing (TAMC/TYMC) on these materials and set strict limits.

blocks.zh: 注意：ASTM F838-20 是過濾器細菌截留驗證的標準，替代傳統的熱原驗證（Eur. Ph. 5.1.1 模式），對 ATMP 物料而言是被接受的通用過濾驗證方法。
blocks.en: Note: ASTM F838-20 is the standard for validating bacterial retention of filters. It replaces the traditional pyrogen validation (the Eur. Ph. 5.1.1 model) and is an accepted, generally applicable filter validation method for ATMP materials.

blocks.zh: 自體療法豁免注意事項
blocks.en: Caveats on the Autologous Exemption

blocks.zh: 「自體細胞治療通常豁免於供體（病患）測試」這一規定來自 21 CFR 1271，邏輯是：病患接受的是自己的細胞，傳染病傳播風險已自我承擔，無需對供體（病患本人）執行傳染病篩檢。
blocks.en: The rule that "autologous cell therapies are generally exempt from donor (patient) testing" comes from 21 CFR 1271. The logic is that patients receive their own cells, so they already bear the risk of disease transmission and infectious disease screening of the donor (the patient) is unnecessary.

blocks.zh: 然而，這個豁免只適用於供體（病患）測試，並不豁免其他物料（如培養基成分、細胞激素）的安全性要求。CDMO 操作自體療法計畫時，應特別注意此豁免的邊界。
blocks.en: However, this exemption applies only to donor (patient) testing. It does not waive the safety requirements for other materials (such as medium components and cytokines). A CDMO running an autologous program should pay close attention to the boundary of this exemption.

blocks.zh: 一個 ATMP 製造使用了含 FBS 的培養基，供應商提供了 0.2 µm 過濾憑證。依據 PtC-13，這樣的憑證是否足夠？您還需要哪些補充措施？
blocks.en: An ATMP is manufactured using a medium containing FBS, and the supplier provided a 0.2 µm filtration certificate. According to PtC-13, is such a certificate sufficient? What additional measures do you need?

blocks.zh: TSE/BSE 的 Prion 為何無法被一般滅菌方法消滅？這對物料來源管理有何意義？
blocks.en: Why can the prions of TSE/BSE not be eliminated by ordinary sterilization methods? What does this mean for the management of material sourcing?

blocks.zh: Eur. Ph. 5.1.1 與 ASTM F838-20 在無菌保證驗證上有何本質差異？為何後者對 ATMP 物料更具實用性？
blocks.en: What is the fundamental difference between Eur. Ph. 5.1.1 and ASTM F838-20 in sterility assurance validation, and why is the latter more practical for ATMP materials?

blocks.zh: Table 3.2-1🔍 — Overview of Relevant Guidelines Related to Microbial/Viral Safety & TSE/BSE/CJD Safety Table 3.2-1🔍 — 微生物／病毒安全性及 TSE/BSE/CJD 安全性相關指引概述
blocks.en: Table 3.2-1🔍 — Overview of Relevant Guidelines Related to Microbial/Viral Safety & TSE/BSE/CJD Safety🔍

blocks.zh: 表格解讀 — Table 3.2-1🔍 的四大物料分類邏輯
blocks.en: Reading the Table — The Four Material Categories in Table 3.2-1🔍

blocks.zh: 這張表格按照「物料的生物來源風險」由低至高排列，是 ATMP 物料管理最重要的分類框架：
blocks.en: The table is arranged from low to high biological source risk of the material and is the most important classification framework for ATMP material management:

blocks.zh: 非人/非動物來源：風險最低，適用一般 GMP（美國 21 CFR + 歐盟 Vol.4）。但仍需定義微生物/病毒安全控制策略（污染控制策略的一部分）。
blocks.en: Non-human/non-animal origin: Lowest risk; general GMP applies (US 21 CFR + EU Vol. 4). A microbial/viral safety control strategy (as part of the contamination control strategy) still has to be defined.

blocks.zh: 人血液來源：適用高度專門化的法規（21 CFR 610/640、Ph. Eur. 5.2.12），尤其需要關注 CJD 風險（2022 FDA 指引）。
blocks.en: Human blood origin: Highly specialized regulations apply (21 CFR 610/640, Ph. Eur. 5.2.12), with particular attention to CJD risk (2022 FDA guidance).

blocks.zh: 人組織/細胞來源：法規最複雜，覆蓋 FDA、EMA、日本 MHLW，且涉及供體資格審核 (donor eligibility)和傳染病篩檢要求。
blocks.en: Human tissue/cell origin: The most complex regulatory landscape, covering FDA, EMA and Japan MHLW, and involving donor eligibility and infectious disease screening requirements.

blocks.zh: 動物來源（FBS）：需符合 USDA 9 CFR 113、ICH Q5A 和 WHO TSE 指引，重點在病毒安全性驗證。
blocks.en: Animal origin (FBS): Must comply with USDA 9 CFR 113, ICH Q5A and the WHO TSE guidelines, with the focus on viral safety validation.

blocks.zh: 法規地圖 — CDMO 同時服務美/歐/日三市場的物料合規矩陣
blocks.en: Regulatory Map — A Material Compliance Matrix for a CDMO Serving the US, EU and Japan

物料類型         美國              歐盟              日本
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
非人/非動物     21 CFR GMP        Vol.4 ATMP         MHLW
人血液          21 CFR 610/640    Ph.Eur. 5.2.12     JSBRM
人組織/細胞     21 CFR 1271.50    Dir. 2004/23/EC    PFSB 1213002
                FDA CGT 2020      Dir. 2006/86/EC
動物(FBS)       9 CFR 113         EMA/410/01         JSBRM
                ICH Q5A           ICH Q5A
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
注意：ICH Q5A（病毒安全性）是美/歐/日三方共同認可的
      harmonized 標準，是最具跨地區適用性的基準。
blocks.en:
Material type      US                EU                 Japan
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Non-human/animal   21 CFR GMP        Vol.4 ATMP         MHLW
Human blood        21 CFR 610/640    Ph.Eur. 5.2.12     JSBRM
Human tissue/cell  21 CFR 1271.50    Dir. 2004/23/EC    PFSB 1213002
                   FDA CGT 2020      Dir. 2006/86/EC
Animal (FBS)       9 CFR 113         EMA/410/01         JSBRM
                   ICH Q5A           ICH Q5A
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Note: ICH Q5A (viral safety) is a harmonized standard accepted
      jointly by the US, EU and Japan, and is the most widely
      applicable benchmark across regions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 及早進行 Gap Assessment 避免 IND/BLA 延誤
blocks.en: Key Point — Perform a Gap Assessment Early to Avoid IND/BLA Delays

blocks.zh: PtC-13 特別警示：各地健康主管機關的要求可能有顯著差異，建議在早期開發階段就進行Gap Assessment（差距評估），並諮詢目標地區的健康主管機關。
blocks.en: PtC-13 specifically warns that the requirements of health authorities in different regions may differ significantly. A Gap Assessment should be performed during early development, together with consultation of the health authorities in the target regions.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務場景：一個美國 Phase II 的 CAR-T 計畫，若計畫同步申請歐盟 IMPD，供應商只有 9 CFR 113（美國 USDA）的 FBS 認證，卻沒有 EMA/410/01 的 TSE 證明，可能導致歐盟 IMPD 審核時被要求補件，延誤整個計畫時程。早規劃 = 早解決問題。
blocks.en: CDMO practical scenario: a US Phase II CAR-T program also plans to file an EU IMPD. If the supplier holds only the 9 CFR 113 (US USDA) certification for the FBS and has no TSE statement under EMA/410/01, the EU IMPD review may request additional documents and delay the whole program timeline. Planning early = solving problems early.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — HEK293 細胞銀行的多法規合規挑戰
blocks.en: Practical Application — The Multi-Regulation Compliance Challenge of a HEK293 Cell Bank

blocks.zh: HEK293（人胚腎細胞系）是 ATMP 製造中最常用的包裝細胞系，屬於「人組織/細胞來源」，需同時符合：
blocks.en: HEK293 (human embryonic kidney cell line) is the most commonly used packaging cell line in ATMP manufacturing. It falls under "human tissue/cell origin" and must comply with all of the following at once:

blocks.zh: 21 CFR 1271.50（美國細胞組織法規）
blocks.en: 21 CFR 1271.50 (US cell and tissue regulation)

blocks.zh: FDA 2010 指引（細胞基質特性描述）
blocks.en: FDA 2010 guidance (characterization of cell substrates)

blocks.zh: EU Directive 2004/23/EC（歐盟組織細胞品質標準）
blocks.en: EU Directive 2004/23/EC (EU quality standards for tissues and cells)

blocks.zh: Ph. Eur. 5.2.12（歐洲藥典細胞基質檢驗）
blocks.en: Ph. Eur. 5.2.12 (European Pharmacopoeia testing of cell substrates)

blocks.zh: USP <1046>（細胞治療產品）
blocks.en: USP <1046> (cell therapy products)

blocks.zh: 一個完整的 HEK293 Master Cell Bank 建立計畫，必須在 MCB 建立前就確認上述所有法規要求，否則後期補測非常昂貴且耗時。
blocks.en: A complete HEK293 Master Cell Bank establishment plan must confirm all of the above regulatory requirements before the MCB is established. Otherwise, later supplementary testing is very expensive and time-consuming.

blocks.zh: Q3.2 Continued — Allogeneic-Specific Considerations & ID Testing Requirements Q3.2 續 — 同種異體特定考量及鑑別測試要求
blocks.en: Q3.2 Continued — Allogeneic-Specific Considerations & ID Testing Requirements

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 自體 vs 異體療法的物料測試差異
blocks.en: Core Concept — Material Testing Differences between Autologous and Allogeneic Therapies

blocks.zh: Autologous（自體）療法：病患即供體，細胞來源確定，傳染病傳播風險「回到自身」，依 21 CFR 1271，通常豁免供體測試。但製造物料（培養基等）仍需完整合格審定。
blocks.en: Autologous therapy: The patient is the donor and the cell source is known. The risk of disease transmission "returns to the patient", so under 21 CFR 1271 donor testing is generally exempt. Manufacturing materials (medium and so on) still require full qualification.

blocks.zh: Allogeneic（異體）療法：一名供體的細胞治療多名病患，傳染病傳播風險大幅提高。除了初次捐贈時的供體篩檢，還需要在細胞銀行 (cell bank) 建立期間和藥物製造過程中進行多層次安全測試。
blocks.en: Allogeneic therapy: Cells from one donor treat multiple patients, which greatly increases the risk of disease transmission. In addition to donor screening at the initial donation, multi-layered safety testing is required during cell bank establishment and during drug manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 這就是為何異體療法的物料測試要求遠比自體療法嚴格——一個受汙染的 Master Cell Bank，可能影響未來數千名病患。
blocks.en: This is why the material testing requirements for allogeneic therapies are far stricter than for autologous therapies: a single contaminated Master Cell Bank could affect thousands of future patients.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 異體療法的「一對多」風險倍增效應
blocks.en: Analogy — The "One-to-Many" Risk Multiplier of Allogeneic Therapy

blocks.zh: 想像一個血庫：若一袋血液受到 HIV 汙染，只有接受這袋血的一位病患受害（類似自體）。但若一個異體 CAR-T 細胞銀行受汙染，而這個銀行生產的細胞被分配給 500 位病患，則有 500 位病患可能受害。
blocks.en: Imagine a blood bank. If one bag of blood is contaminated with HIV, only the one patient who receives that bag is harmed (similar to autologous). But if an allogeneic CAR-T cell bank is contaminated and the cells it produces are distributed to 500 patients, 500 patients may be harmed.

blocks.zh: 這就是 PtC-13 強調異體療法需要「多層次測試（donor cells → cell banks → DS/DP manufacturing）」的根本原因：越早發現問題，影響越少病患，代價越小。
blocks.en: This is the fundamental reason PtC-13 stresses that allogeneic therapies need "multi-layered testing (donor cells → cell banks → DS/DP manufacturing)": the earlier a problem is found, the fewer patients are affected and the lower the cost.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，承接異體 ATMP 計畫意味著需要建立更完整的細胞銀行品質體系（符合 PIC/S Annex 2A §5.30–5.38）。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, taking on an allogeneic ATMP program means building a more complete cell bank quality system (in line with PIC/S Annex 2A §5.30-5.38).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 供體同意書的商業化陷阱
blocks.en: Key Point — The Commercialization Trap of Donor Consent

blocks.zh: PtC-13 特別提醒：必須確保供體的商業使用同意 (donor consent for commercial usage)。這在早期臨床試驗中常被忽視，但在商業化申請（BLA/MAA）時可能成為阻礙。
blocks.en: PtC-13 specifically reminds that donor consent for commercial usage must be ensured. This is often overlooked in early clinical trials but can become an obstacle at the time of a commercial application (BLA/MAA).

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務建議：在異體 ATMP 計畫的細胞捐贈協議（Donation Agreement）中，應明確包含商業生產用途的同意條款。若客戶在 Phase I 時已捐贈的細胞缺少此條款，後期重新取得同意書在實務上可能非常困難（供體已故、失聯等情況）。
blocks.en: CDMO practice recommendation: the Donation Agreement for an allogeneic ATMP program should explicitly include a consent clause for commercial manufacturing use. If cells donated during Phase I lack this clause, obtaining consent again later can be very difficult in practice (donor deceased, lost to contact, and so on).

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — US vs EU 的 ID Testing 哲學差異
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Philosophical Difference in ID Testing between the US and the EU

blocks.zh: 美國 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2) — 強制性 Specific Identity Test：
blocks.en: US 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2) — Mandatory Specific Identity Test:

blocks.zh: 每批收到的原料都必須執行至少一項特異性身份鑑別測試 (specific identity test)。若無特異性測試，可使用組合替代測試（大小、純度、光譜輪廓）。這是強制規定，不能以 CoA 取代。
blocks.en: Every lot of raw material received must undergo at least one specific identity test. If no specific test is available, a combination of substitute tests (size, purity, spectral profile) may be used. This is a mandatory requirement and cannot be replaced by a CoA.

blocks.zh: 歐盟 EudraLex Vol. 4 — 基於風險的 CoA 接受：
blocks.en: EU EudraLex Vol. 4 — Risk-Based CoA Acceptance:

blocks.zh: 允許以供應商 CoA 接受物料（前提是風險充分評估並有適當緩解措施），但建議對關鍵原料（如賦形劑）執行 ID 測試。這是建議性規定，有更大的靈活空間。
blocks.en: Materials may be accepted on the basis of the supplier CoA (provided the risks are adequately assessed and appropriate mitigations are in place), but ID testing of critical raw materials (such as excipients) is recommended. This is a recommendation, which leaves more room for flexibility.

blocks.zh: 一個異體 CAR-T 計畫從 Phase I 進入 Phase III，原先的供體同意書沒有涵蓋商業用途。您作為 CDMO 的 QA 主管，應如何處理？
blocks.en: An allogeneic CAR-T program is moving from Phase I to Phase III, and the original donor consent forms do not cover commercial use. As the QA head of the CDMO, how would you handle this?

blocks.zh: 對於一種新型細胞激素，目前市面上沒有公認的「specific identity test」，依照 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2)，您應如何設計替代測試策略？
blocks.en: For a novel cytokine, no recognized "specific identity test" is currently available on the market. How would you design a substitute testing strategy under 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2)?

blocks.zh: 異體療法的細胞銀行建立，為何需要符合 PIC/S Annex 2A §5.30–5.38？這些條款的核心要求是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does cell bank establishment for an allogeneic therapy need to comply with PIC/S Annex 2A §5.30-5.38, and what are the core requirements of these clauses?

blocks.zh: Table 3.2-2🔍 — US vs EU GMP Regulations for Material ID Testing & Figure 3.2-1🔍 Table 3.2-2🔍 — 美國與歐盟物料鑑別測試 GMP 法規毒較及 Figure 3.2-1🔍
blocks.en: Table 3.2-2🔍 — US vs EU GMP Regulations for Material ID Testing & Figure 3.2-1🔍🔍🔍

blocks.zh: 表格解讀 — Table 3.2-2🔍 核心差異一覽
blocks.en: Reading the Table — Key Differences in Table 3.2-2🔍 at a Glance

blocks.zh:
維度           美國 (21 CFR 211)    歐盟 (EudraLex Vol.4)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Phase I       豁免（21 CFR 210.2c） 可依 CoA 接受
Phase II+     必須符合全 GMP        可依 CoA 接受（風險評估）
ID Test       強制：每批至少1項      建議：關鍵物料應做
              特異性測試             可由 CoA + 供應商資格替代
CoA 接受       僅限供替代其他測試    風險評估後可全面接受
              但 ID test 不可省略
執行靈活性     較低（強制性）         較高（風險導向）

關鍵結論：同時服務美/歐市場的 CDMO 應以
          "美國標準" 為底線——Phase II 起
          必須對每批原料執行 ID test。
blocks.en:
Dimension      US (21 CFR 211)          EU (EudraLex Vol.4)
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Phase I        Exempt (21 CFR 210.2c)   May accept on CoA
Phase II+      Full GMP required        May accept on CoA (risk assessment)
ID Test        Mandatory: at least 1    Recommended: critical materials
               specific test per lot    should be tested; may be replaced by
                                        CoA + supplier qualification
CoA acceptance Only as a substitute     Fully acceptable after risk
               for other tests; the ID  assessment
               test cannot be omitted
Flexibility    Lower (mandatory)        Higher (risk-based)

Key conclusion: a CDMO serving both the US and EU markets should use
          the "US standard" as the baseline - from Phase II onward,
          an ID test must be performed on every lot of raw material.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 — Figure 3.2-1🔍 決策流程解析
blocks.en: Reading the Figure — Analysis of the Decision Flow in Figure 3.2-1🔍

blocks.zh: Figure 3.2-1🔍 描繪了一個雙軌決策流程，協助 ATMP 製造商判斷每種物料的 ID 測試策略：
blocks.en: Figure 3.2-1🔍 depicts a dual-track decision flow that helps ATMP manufacturers determine the ID testing strategy for each material:

blocks.zh: 美國路徑（左側）：
blocks.en: US pathway (left side):

blocks.zh: Phase I → 豁免（21 CFR 210.2c）
blocks.en: Phase I → exempt (21 CFR 210.2c)

blocks.zh: Phase II/III/商業化 → 強制 ID test（21 CFR 211.84(d)(2)）
blocks.en: Phase II/III/commercial → mandatory ID test (21 CFR 211.84(d)(2))

blocks.zh: 有特異性測試方法 → 執行特異性測試
blocks.en: Specific test method available → perform the specific test

blocks.zh: 無特異性測試方法 → 組合替代測試（大小 + 純度 + 光譜）
blocks.en: No specific test method available → combination of substitute tests (size + purity + spectrum)

blocks.zh: 歐盟路徑（右側）：
blocks.en: EU pathway (right side):

blocks.zh: 任何階段 → 評估是否已充分了解所有風險
blocks.en: Any stage → assess whether all risks are adequately understood

blocks.zh: 是 + 有緩解措施（供應商資格審計）→ 可接受 CoA
blocks.en: Yes + mitigation in place (supplier qualification audit) → CoA may be accepted

blocks.zh: 否 或 關鍵物料 → 執行 ID 測試（建議性）
blocks.en: No, or critical material → perform ID test (recommended)

blocks.zh: 對同時申請美/歐的計畫，應取兩者較嚴格的要求（美國標準）作為操作基線。
blocks.en: For programs filed in both the US and the EU, the stricter of the two requirements (the US standard) should be used as the operating baseline.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — USP <1043> Tier 1 的特殊豁免
blocks.en: Key Point — The Special Exemption for USP <1043> Tier 1

blocks.zh: 依 USP <1043>（Ancillary Materials），Tier 1 輔助材料定義為：已獲 FDA 批准用於其他用途的藥物或醫療器材（例如：FDA 核准的注射劑賦形劑），在 ATMP 製造中作為原料使用時，可以直接依供應商 CoA 接受，不需自行確認測試結果。
blocks.en: Under USP <1043> (Ancillary Materials), a Tier 1 ancillary material is a drug or medical device already approved by FDA for another use (for example, an FDA-approved injectable excipient). When used as a raw material in ATMP manufacturing, it may be accepted directly on the basis of the supplier CoA, without confirmatory testing of the results.

blocks.zh: 這是美國體系中少數允許「跳過 ID test 強制性要求」的例外情況，其邏輯是：FDA 已對這些材料進行了審查（在原有批准用途中），製造商可合理信任其品質系統。但這個豁免有嚴格的前提——物料必須是FDA approved 的藥品或醫療器材等級，而非僅有供應商聲明。
blocks.en: This is one of the few exceptions in the US system that allows the mandatory ID test requirement to be skipped. The logic is that FDA has already reviewed these materials (for their original approved use), so the manufacturer can reasonably rely on their quality system. The exemption has a strict precondition, however: the material must be of FDA approved drug or medical device grade, not merely backed by a supplier statement.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 同時服務美/歐 CDMO 的 ID Testing SOP 設計
blocks.en: Practical Application — Designing an ID Testing SOP for a CDMO Serving Both the US and the EU

blocks.zh: 建議 CDMO 建立一套統一的 ID Testing 決策 SOP，流程如下：
blocks.en: We recommend that the CDMO establish a single ID Testing decision SOP with the following flow:

blocks.zh: 確認計畫目標市場（美國/歐盟/兩者）
blocks.en: Confirm the target market of the program (US / EU / both)

blocks.zh: 確認臨床階段（Phase I → 美國豁免；Phase II+ → 美國強制 ID test）
blocks.en: Confirm the clinical phase (Phase I → US exempt; Phase II+ → US mandatory ID test)

blocks.zh: 物料分類（非人/非動物 vs 人血液 vs 動物來源）
blocks.en: Classify the material (non-human/non-animal vs human blood vs animal origin)

blocks.zh: 是否為 USP <1043> Tier 1？若是 → 可依 CoA 接受（僅美國）
blocks.en: Is it USP <1043> Tier 1? If yes → may be accepted on the CoA (US only)

blocks.zh: 有無 specific identity test 方法？若有 → 執行；若無 → 設計組合替代測試
blocks.en: Is there a specific identity test method? If yes → perform it; if no → design a combination of substitute tests

blocks.zh: 記錄決策依據（法規引用 + 風險評估）於物料規格書或 QRM 文件中
blocks.en: Document the basis for the decision (regulatory citation + risk assessment) in the material specification or the QRM documentation

blocks.zh: 一種 ATMP 製造用的重組細胞激素（recombinant cytokine），供應商為研究試劑廠，提供了 SDS-PAGE 和 ELISA 報告作為 CoA。依美國 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2)，這樣的 CoA 能否取代 ID test？您需要採取哪些行動？
blocks.en: A recombinant cytokine used in ATMP manufacturing comes from a research-reagent supplier, who provides SDS-PAGE and ELISA reports as the CoA. Under US 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2), can such a CoA replace the ID test? What actions do you need to take?

blocks.zh: Table 3.2-2🔍 中，EudraLex Vol.4 §7.15 允許「CoA 接受」的前提條件是什麼？在實際 QA 操作中，「充分了解風險 (all risks are duly understood)」應如何文件化？
blocks.en: In Table 3.2-2🔍, what are the preconditions under which EudraLex Vol. 4 §7.15 allows "CoA acceptance"? In day-to-day QA practice, how should "all risks are duly understood" be documented?

blocks.zh: 一個 Phase II 的 ATMP 計畫正在準備向 FDA 遞交 IND 修正。製造商使用了 10 種原料，其中 3 種為動物來源，2 種為化學定義合成物，5 種為人組織來源。請依 Table 3.2-2🔍 的框架，說明各類物料的 ID testing 策略。
blocks.en: A Phase II ATMP program is preparing an IND amendment for submission to FDA. The manufacturer uses 10 raw materials: 3 of animal origin, 2 chemically defined synthetic compounds and 5 of human tissue origin. Using the framework of Table 3.2-2🔍, describe the ID testing strategy for each category of material.

blocks.zh: Q3.2 Continued — Material Sampling, Retain Requirements & Phase-Appropriate Considerations Q3.2 續 — 物料取樣、留樣要求及階段適切性考量
blocks.en: Q3.2 Continued — Material Sampling, Retain Requirements & Phase-Appropriate Considerations

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 取樣/留樣策略的 ATMP 特殊挑戰
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Particular ATMP Challenges of Sampling and Retention Strategy

blocks.zh: 傳統藥物製造中，留樣（retention sample）是常規操作，沒有特別難度。但 ATMP 物料有兩個獨特挑戰：
blocks.en: In traditional drug manufacturing, retaining samples (retention samples) is routine and presents no special difficulty. ATMP materials, however, pose two unique challenges:

blocks.zh: 1. 起始物料（如自體細胞）數量極為有限：一個自體 CAR-T 療程，病患的血球採集量可能就只夠製造一個批次，根本沒有多餘量留樣。PtC-13 認可此「固有限制 (intrinsic limitation)」可以成為豁免留樣的依據，但需要文件化替代緩解措施。
blocks.en: 1. Very limited quantity of starting material (such as autologous cells): For one autologous CAR-T treatment, the patient's leukapheresis collection may be only enough to make a single batch, leaving no surplus for retention. PtC-13 recognizes this "intrinsic limitation" as a basis for exempting retention, but alternative mitigation measures must be documented.

blocks.zh: 2. 冷凍物料的凍融次數限制：許多 ATMP 物料（如細胞激素、病毒載體）在冷凍儲存，每次凍融都會降低品質。建議使用專用 QC 小瓶 (dedicated QC vials)，避免因 QC 取樣而對主批次造成額外凍融損傷。
blocks.en: 2. Limits on freeze-thaw cycles for frozen materials: Many ATMP materials (such as cytokines and viral vectors) are stored frozen, and every freeze-thaw cycle reduces quality. We recommend dedicated QC vials so that QC sampling does not cause additional freeze-thaw damage to the main batch.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 臨床階段就像學生到職場的成長歷程
blocks.en: Analogy — Clinical Phases Are Like a Student's Growth into the Workplace

blocks.zh: 早期臨床（Phase I）就像剛進入職場的新鮮人：公司允許一定的學習曲線，不要求一開始就達到全部的成熟員工標準（GMP 豁免）。
blocks.en: Early clinical (Phase I) is like a new graduate just entering the workplace: the company allows a learning curve and does not expect the full standard of a mature employee from the start (GMP exemption).

blocks.zh: 但當你進入 Phase II（穩定工作後），公司開始要求你完全遵守所有工作規定（21 CFR 211 全面適用）。到了商業化階段（正式員工），不僅要遵守規定，還要能夠自主制定標準（內部物料規格），而不是照抄供應商的規格（就像資深員工要能獨立判斷，不依賴初入職時的操作手冊）。
blocks.en: When you reach Phase II (after settling into the job), the company starts to require full compliance with all work rules (21 CFR 211 applies in full). At the commercial stage (a permanent employee), you must not only follow the rules but also be able to set standards on your own (internal material specifications) rather than copy the supplier's specifications (just as a senior employee must judge independently and not rely on the manual from the first day on the job).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — RUO 物料使用的紅線管理
blocks.en: Key Point — Managing the Red Lines for RUO Material Use

blocks.zh: RUO（Research Use Only，僅供研究用途）物料是 ATMP 早期開發中最常見的風險來源之一。PtC-13 的立場是：盡量避免使用，但若不可避免，必須執行正式風險評估。
blocks.en: RUO (Research Use Only) materials are one of the most common sources of risk in early ATMP development. The position of PtC-13 is: avoid them where possible, but if unavoidable, a formal risk assessment must be performed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務的三個 RUO 使用紅線：
blocks.en: Three red lines for RUO use in CDMO practice:

blocks.zh: 紅線 1：商業化階段（BLA/MAA 後）禁止使用 RUO 物料——這是法規底線。
blocks.en: Red line 1: RUO materials must not be used at the commercial stage (after BLA/MAA). This is the regulatory bottom line.

blocks.zh: 紅線 2：在 Phase I 使用 RUO 物料時，毒理研究與 Phase I 臨床物料應使用同一批次（減少批次差異風險）。
blocks.en: Red line 2: When RUO materials are used in Phase I, the toxicology studies and the Phase I clinical material should use the same lot (to reduce the risk of lot-to-lot variation).

blocks.zh: 紅線 3：若 RUO 物料缺乏滅菌保證，必須在進入無菌製程前執行過濾滅菌 + 完整性測試。
blocks.en: Red line 3: If an RUO material lacks sterility assurance, filter sterilization plus an integrity test must be performed before it enters the sterile process.

blocks.zh: 並行合格審定 (Concurrent Qualification) 的啟動條件
blocks.en: Conditions for Starting Concurrent Qualification

blocks.zh:
並行合格審定三大前提條件（缺一不可）：
─────────────────────────────────────
條件 1: Quality Unit 書面批准 concurrent qualification 的使用

條件 2: 至少 1 個批次通過全部測試項目
        （不得全部都是「並行進行」的批次）

條件 3: 若利用先前已合格物料的資料，需滿足：
  (a) 同一製造商（不同料號），變更原因為製程調整
  (b) 技術評估顯示新舊物料等效
  (c) 供應商在核准供應商清單 (ASL) 上
─────────────────────────────────────
傳統要求：至少 3 個批次，在製程驗證前完成
並行合格：風險較高，需要 QA 書面批准，
          適用於供貨緊張或計畫時程緊迫的情況
blocks.en:
Three prerequisites for concurrent qualification (all must be met):
─────────────────────────────────────
Condition 1: The Quality Unit approves the use of concurrent
             qualification in writing

Condition 2: At least 1 lot passes all test items
             (the lots must not all be "concurrent" lots)

Condition 3: If data from a previously qualified material are
             used, the following must be met:
  (a) Same manufacturer (different item number), with the
      change due to a process adjustment
  (b) Technical assessment shows the new and old materials
      are equivalent
  (c) The supplier is on the approved supplier list (ASL)
─────────────────────────────────────
Traditional requirement: at least 3 lots, completed before
             process validation
Concurrent qualification: higher risk; requires written QA
             approval; suitable when supply is tight or the
             program timeline is urgent

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 商業化物料規格不能照抄供應商規格
blocks.en: Key Point — Commercial Material Specifications Must Not Simply Copy the Supplier's

blocks.zh: PtC-13 特別強調：商業化階段的內部物料規格（internal material specification）不應是供應商規格的複製品，除非有正當理由。
blocks.en: PtC-13 specifically stresses that at the commercial stage the internal material specification should not be a copy of the supplier specification unless justified.

blocks.zh: 原因：供應商的規格是針對其通用客戶群設計的，例如：一個細胞激素供應商的規格可能只要求「生物活性 ≥ 80%」，但您的特定 ATMP 製造製程可能需要「生物活性 ≥ 95%」才能確保產品 CQA 達標。若直接接受供應商規格，等於放棄了針對特定製程的品質把控。
blocks.en: The reason: supplier specifications are designed for the supplier's general customer base. For example, a cytokine supplier's specification may only require "biological activity ≥ 80%", while your particular ATMP manufacturing process may need "biological activity ≥ 95%" to ensure the product CQAs are met. Accepting the supplier specification as is amounts to giving up process-specific quality control.

blocks.zh: CDMO 建議：在製程開發（PD）階段，系統性收集物料 CoA 數據（尤其是關鍵參數的批次間差異），作為設定內部物料規格的科學依據。
blocks.en: CDMO recommendation: during process development (PD), systematically collect material CoA data (especially lot-to-lot variation in critical parameters) as the scientific basis for setting internal material specifications.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 可沖出物/可萃出物 (Leachables and Extractables) 的重要性
blocks.en: Core Concept — The Importance of Leachables and Extractables

blocks.zh: Extractables (E): 在極端條件下（如強溶劑、高溫）從接觸物料中萃取的化學物質——用於了解最壞情況下的化學物質潛在風險。
blocks.en: Extractables (E): Chemicals extracted from contact materials under extreme conditions (such as strong solvents or high temperature). They are used to understand the potential chemical risks in the worst case.

blocks.zh: Leachables (L): 在正常製程條件下實際從接觸物料遷移進入藥品的化學物質——直接影響病患安全。
blocks.en: Leachables (L): Chemicals that actually migrate from contact materials into the drug product under normal process conditions. They directly affect patient safety.

blocks.zh: 對 ATMP 而言，含 DMSO（二甲亞碸） 的冷凍保存液（cryoprotectant）是特別需要關注 E&L 的場景，因為 DMSO 是強溶劑，能顯著增加塑料容器中化學物質的遷移量。此研究數據在晚期臨床/商業化申請中可能被法規要求提供。
blocks.en: For ATMPs, cryopreservation solutions (cryoprotectants) containing DMSO (dimethyl sulfoxide) are a scenario that calls for particular attention to E&L, because DMSO is a strong solvent that can markedly increase the migration of chemicals from plastic containers. Regulators may require these study data in late-stage clinical/commercial applications.

blocks.zh: 一個自體 CAR-T 計畫，每個病患的採集量僅夠製造一個批次，無多餘的起始材料留樣。依 PtC-13，如何合理豁免留樣要求？應採取哪些替代緩解措施？
blocks.en: An autologous CAR-T program collects only enough material per patient to make a single batch, leaving no surplus starting material for retention. According to PtC-13, how can the retention requirement be reasonably waived? What alternative mitigation measures should be taken?

blocks.zh: 一個 CDMO 正在為客戶的 Phase III 計畫做物料規格升級準備。發現目前使用的 IL-2（白介素-2）的內部規格與供應商規格完全相同，且供應商規格的生物活性下限為 75%。您作為 QA 負責人，應如何評估並提出建議？
blocks.en: A CDMO is preparing to upgrade material specifications for a client's Phase III program. It finds that the internal specification for the IL-2 (interleukin-2) currently in use is identical to the supplier specification, and the supplier's lower limit for biological activity is 75%. As the QA lead, how would you assess this and what would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 什麼情況下允許啟動並行合格審定 (Concurrent Qualification)？如果一種物料的三批次中只有 1 批通過了測試，是否符合 PtC-13 的要求？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances may concurrent qualification be started? If only 1 of 3 lots of a material passed testing, does that meet the PtC-13 requirements?

blocks.zh: DMSO 保存液為何是 ATMP 製程中 Leachables & Extractables 研究的重點？應針對哪些包材/接觸物料進行 E&L 研究？
blocks.en: Why is a DMSO cryopreservation solution a focus of Leachables & Extractables studies in ATMP processes? Which packaging materials/contact materials should be covered by E&L studies?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary — Q3.1 & Q3.2 Risk-Based Material Qualification
blocks.en: Section Summary — Q3.1 & Q3.2 Risk-Based Material Qualification

blocks.zh: 風險導向框架：ATMP 物料合格審定依物料來源（非人/非動物 → 人血液 → 人組織 → 動物）的生物風險層級，分配不同嚴格度的測試要求，參考 PDA TR81 的風險評估範例。
blocks.en: Risk-based framework: ATMP material qualification assigns testing requirements of differing rigor according to the biological risk tier of the material source (non-human/non-animal → human blood → human tissue → animal), with reference to the risk assessment examples in PDA TR81.

blocks.zh: 生物安全雙面向：TSE/BSE/CJD 風險需透過「受控來源」管理（Prion 無法被一般滅菌消滅）；無菌保證需注意 ATMP 物料通常不符合 Eur. Ph. 5.1.1，須透過已驗證的 0.2 µm 過濾 + ASTM F838-20 標準緩解風險。
blocks.en: Two dimensions of biological safety: TSE/BSE/CJD risk must be managed through "controlled sourcing" (prions cannot be eliminated by ordinary sterilization); for sterility assurance, note that ATMP materials generally do not meet Eur. Ph. 5.1.1, and the risk must be mitigated through validated 0.2 µm filtration plus the ASTM F838-20 standard.

blocks.zh: Table 3.2-1🔍 四大物料類別：非人/非動物來源（最低風險，一般 GMP）、人血液（21 CFR 610/640、Ph. Eur. 5.2.12）、人組織/細胞（最複雜，需供體資格審核 + 多層次測試）、動物來源（9 CFR 113、ICH Q5A、TSE 管控）。
blocks.en: The four material categories of Table 3.2-1🔍: non-human/non-animal origin (lowest risk, general GMP), human blood (21 CFR 610/640, Ph. Eur. 5.2.12), human tissue/cells (most complex; donor eligibility + multi-layered testing), animal origin (9 CFR 113, ICH Q5A, TSE control).

blocks.zh: US vs EU ID Testing 關鍵差異：美國 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2) 強制要求每批至少 1 項特異性 ID test（Phase I 豁免，Phase II 起適用）；歐盟 EudraLex Vol.4 §7.15 允許風險評估後以 CoA 接受，ID test 為建議性。同時服務兩市場時，應以美國標準為底線。
blocks.en: Key US vs EU differences in ID testing: US 21 CFR 211.84(d)(2) mandates at least 1 specific ID test per lot (exempt in Phase I, applicable from Phase II); EU EudraLex Vol. 4 §7.15 allows CoA acceptance after risk assessment, with ID testing recommended. When serving both markets, use the US standard as the baseline.

blocks.zh: 自體 vs 異體差異：自體療法依 21 CFR 1271 豁免供體測試；異體療法需多層次測試（供體細胞 → 細胞銀行 → DS/DP 製造），並務必取得供體的商業用途同意。
blocks.en: Autologous vs allogeneic differences: Autologous therapies are exempt from donor testing under 21 CFR 1271; allogeneic therapies need multi-layered testing (donor cells → cell banks → DS/DP manufacturing), and donor consent for commercial use must be obtained.

blocks.zh: Phase-Appropriate 升級路徑：Phase I 可用 RUO 物料（需 RA）、依供應商規格；Phase II 起強制 ID test、轉換 GMP 等級；商業化前需完成至少 3 批次物料合格審定（或滿足 3 條件的並行合格）、建立獨立內部規格、完成 E&L 研究。
blocks.en: Phase-appropriate escalation path: In Phase I, RUO materials may be used (with a risk assessment) and supplier specifications relied on; from Phase II, ID testing is mandatory and materials move to GMP grade; before commercialization, qualification of at least 3 lots of material (or concurrent qualification meeting the 3 conditions) must be completed, independent internal specifications established and E&L studies completed.
